decisions.reason: Quotes the exact disabled expression, shows busy is useState-local to sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, and explains both gates: empty occurrences return null before the map; present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard false, evaluating busy and throwing ReferenceError.

Explains the render throw is caught by the per-slot-entry error boundary, unmounting the whole dock entry (not just the remove button), that the attach button is a separate slot entry that survives, and that the only diagnostic is a console ReferenceError with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 expression to establish busy is pre-existing, proposes a data-present plain-phase baseline mount plus rollback/re-add isolation, explicitly avoids claiming the diff is harmless by documenting the diff's added unconditional status crash, the half-guarded record?.items, and the hoisted imageItem inconsistency, and refrains from claiming when historical users first hit the failure.

Removes the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard via hoisted 'locked', hardens items with (record?.items ?? []), uses event.target?.closest?.(), and moves imageItem inside the map callback where record/status are scoped; also discusses a properly-owned alternative (status === 'uploading').

Proposes a mount test with one occurrence in plain phase asserting chip/remove exist and boundary.errors is empty, explains empty-state-only tests pass on the broken build and that node --check only parses without scope resolution or execution, and requires a data-present slot smoke in pre-ship checks.
